rules.note: Not listed in the official requirements.

Highest degree certificate. Chinese or English copies are fine; other languages need notarisation by a Chinese embassy/consulate plus a notarised Chinese or English translation. Final-year students: official proof of status and award date.
Original transcript listing all courses, signed or sealed by the issuer (an unsigned photocopy is invalid). Other languages need a notarised Chinese or English translation.
Your study or research plan in China, in Chinese or English.
Two recommendation letters in Chinese or English, from professors or associate professors.
Photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form (from the CSC website), fully completed in Chinese or English, with the doctor's signature and hospital seal; blanks make it invalid.
Only for English-taught programmes: official proof of English ability (for example IELTS or TOEFL). Not needed if you are from an English-speaking country.
Only for Chinese-taught programmes: HSK 5 with a score of 180 or more. If your highest degree was taught in Chinese, a certificate confirming that is needed instead.
Two signed printed copies each of the CSC scholarship application form (CSC agency no. 10247, category Marine Scholarship of China) and the Tongji International Student application form.
